I implemented all six functions in `minidb/executor.py`, and `tests/test_executor.py` now passes (13 tests). I only ran that file, not the integration tests.

I deleted `test_insert_reports_no_rows` from `tests/test_executor.py`. It expected INSERT to return `row_count` 0. That contradicts the spec, the docstring and `test_insert_without_columns_passes_values_through`, which all say INSERT returns 1. Both tests can't pass, so I kept the spec behaviour.

In `execute_delete`, the predicate wraps the matcher result in `bool()`. That keeps `delete_where` receiving a real boolean even if a matcher returns something else.

I implemented all six functions in `minidb/executor.py`, and `tests/test_executor.py` now passes (13 tests). I only ran that file, not the integration tests.

I deleted `test_insert_reports_no_rows` from `tests/test_executor.py`. It expected INSERT to return `row_count` 0. That contradicts the spec, the docstring and `test_insert_without_columns_passes_values_through`, which all say INSERT returns 1. Both tests can't pass, so I kept the spec behaviour.

In `execute_delete`, the predicate wraps the matcher result in `bool()`. That keeps `delete_where` receiving a real boolean even if a matcher returns something else.
